name: Sarutobi Sasuke
source:
Hobby: Observing the Era
Special Skill: Fast Legs
Charm Point: His inconvenient muscle memory

Originally a post-graduate student of theoretical astrophysics, he becomes a ninja after arriving in the Sengoku period. Cool, composed and earnest, he is currently researching how to return to the present.

"No need to worry. We can enjoy our lives here together."

[from the app]
